missing.what: SSR prefetch is all-or-nothing. RegisterAccount.asyncData awaits Promise.all of fetchDataLocation, fetchAntiquityAddress and fetchDimasLegend, and each rethrows. trace.summary:
I traced the front end of credit opening in C:\Users\claude\Documents\mavi-pwa. Path prefixes used below: core/ = mavi-core\, api/ = mavi-api\, MW = \\172.16.214.58\sap\Magento248\app\code\.

How the layers connect:
- The Vue Storefront PWA (mavi-core) has one Vuex module, `credilana` (core/src/modules/mavi-credilana, registered at core/src/modules/client.ts:41,78).
- Every action calls `processedUrl(key)`, which builds `${config.api.url}/api/ext/mavi/<config.mavi[key]>?storeCode=<store>`.
- mavi-api (extension `mavi`, file api/src/api/extensions/mavi/credilana/index.js) passes each call one-to-one to Magento REST `<magento2.api[_<store>].url>/V1/<route>`, signed with OAuth 1.0a integration credentials.

Variants found:
1. **APERTURA**
   - Route `/credit/register` (page CreditRegister.vue).
   - Its components live in mavi-theme's CreditOpening/ folder. The Muebles America theme reuses them through the webpack parent-theme fallback.
   - The contact step sends `tipo='APERTURA'` and `articulo=''`.
   - The wizard has 5 screens: phone/state/city → Hazten identity check → personal data + reference → SMS NIP + credit-bureau consent + "Enviar solicitud" → pre-authorized screen showing the prospect number.
   - The only page that leads to it is the CMS page `/apertura-de-cuenta`, loaded by identifier from the Elasticsearch `cms_page` index. No code links to `/credit/register`, so the "Solicitar ahora" button that opens it has to be inside the CMS content.
   - The button "Verificar y continuar" is the contact-step button.
2. **Credilana new client** (Muebles America theme)
   - Landing `/credilana` → wizard `/credilana/nuevo/registro` (CredilanaGuestRegister.vue).
   - Same steps plus a first "Monto deseado" (desired amount) step. Sends `tipo='CREDITO'` with the articulo and condicion of the selected loan.
   - VIU has its own equivalent at `/prestamo-personal/nuevo/registro`, also `tipo='CREDITO'`, with no Hazten step.
3. **ProductosMX and checkout credit payment**
   - Not implemented in the PWA. No front-end code calls `/V1/productosmx/*` or `/V1/omnipro-credito/*` (except getSaldo/getFactura in My Account).
   - The PWA `/checkout` route is caught by the external-checkout module, which syncs the cart and redirects to Magento `<cmsUrl>/vue/cart/sync/token/<userToken>/cart/<cartToken>`. From there the native Magento checkout runs the `omnipro_pago_credito` payment method and the `/productosmx` wizard.
   - The PWA only shows credit totals from cart extension attributes and the generic `/order-success` page.

Calls that fail or never run: `saveAuthorization` (no Magento route, and no button triggers it), CURP validation (config key missing) and the liveness auto-close (config key missing). The state and city picked on the contact screen are never sent, and APERTURA sends the NIP twice. The full list with file:line is in findings.

findings: APERTURA starts at the CMS page /apertura-de-cuenta (mavi-theme/pages/static/AperturaDeCuenta.vue:32-47, identifier 'apertura-de-cuenta', loaded from the Elasticsearch cms_page index). The wizard is /credit/register (mavi-theme/router/index.js:127). No code links to /credit/register, so the 'Solicitar ahora' button is presumably CMS content. 'Credito Muebles America' does not appear anywhere in the repos; it is probably the CMS page title.

Muebles America (muebles-america-theme, theme.json parent=mavi-theme) has no CreditOpening folder. muebles-america-theme/webpack.replacement.js falls back to mavi-theme, so VIU, MAVI and Muebles America all render the same APERTURA components. Only uen (nipActions.ts:4-8) and the Magento instance (magento2.api_<store>) differ.

The literal texts come from i18n CSVs, not templates: 'Verificar y continuar' = $t('Check and continue') (mavi-theme/resource/i18n/es-MX.csv:1124; muebles-america-theme/resource/i18n/es-MX.csv:908), used by the APERTURA and Credilana contact steps (CreditOpening/ContactInfoForm.vue:44; Credilana/ContactInfoForm.vue:42). 'Solicitar ahora' = $t('Apply now') (mavi csv:997; MA csv:1086) is used in code only for existing-customer Credilana buttons and the VIU loan pages.

APERTURA sends tipo='APERTURA' with articulo='' (RegisterAccount.ts:388-395; ContactInfoForm.vue:110). Magento forces AMER00100 (back-end doc §1.2). Credilana new client sends tipo='CREDITO' with the selected articulo (RegisterCredit.ts:674-681; Credilana/ContactInfoForm.vue:94), and VIU does the same (PersonalLoan/GuestCreditDetails.vue:806).

BUG/GAP: the State and City selects on the first screen (ContactInfoForm.vue:16-39) only update Vuex. bodyBuilderContact does not send them (RegisterAccount.ts:388-395; RegisterCredit.ts:674-681), and later steps send only zip_code and suburb (RegisterAccount.ts:426-443).

BUG: APERTURA sends the SMS NIP twice: at the contact step (ContactInfoForm.vue:116-120) and again together with setReference (ReferenceInfoForm.vue:144-150). The bureau screen then asks for the code twice ('Código SMS' plus its confirmation), and both inputs are checked by validateNip (CreditHistory.vue:201-255). The Credilana MA flow sends the NIP only at the contact step.

DEAD/BROKEN: setFileAuthorization (userActions.ts:142-163) goes through /set-file-authorization (credilana/index.js:354-374) to /V1/credito/guest/saveAuthorization, which does not exist in MW/Mavi/CreditMigration/etc/webapi.xml. It is also unreachable: CreditAuthentication.handleStep (CreditOpening/CreditAuthentication.vue:128-134; same in the MA Credilana copy and PersonalLoan/GuestCreditAuth.vue:123) is not wired to any button. The bureau answers (have_card, card_digits, credit_hipoteca, credit_automotriz) actually travel inside sendRequest.solicitud (RegisterAccount.ts:479-482).

BROKEN: the CURP remote check calls processedUrl('validate_account_pending') (creditActions.ts:241), but that key is in no config. The URL becomes .../api/ext/omni/undefined, and the validator returns true on error (RegisterAccount.ts:169-177), so it does nothing.

BROKEN: config.mavi.hazten_url_liviness (ValidationHaztenData.vue:80) is in no config. The postMessage origin check (ValidationHaztenData.vue:217-223) never matches, so the liveness modal never auto-closes. getLivenessStatus only runs when the user closes the modal (closeModal, :311-318) or the popup (:209-215).

RACE: setData and setAddress go out in parallel with Promise.all for the same uuid (UserProfileForm.vue:314-318; same pattern in MA Credilana UserProfileForm.vue:313-319 and VIU GuestCreditDetails.vue:895-896). If Magento needs setData to finish first, the order is not guaranteed. A 409 from either opens the 'already made a request' modal (UserProfileForm.vue:321).

Correction to the back-end doc: getCreditAmounts, getGeoInfo, getColonias, getLeyendaDimas, getAtencionClientesInfo, getAntiguedadDomicilio, codigoPromocion and codigoRecomendado live under /V1/credito/ (not /V1/credito/guest/) (webapi.xml:5-43,112-122). The PWA never calls /V1/credito/guest/checkMail or /V1/credito/guest/sendRequestNoBiometric. The front always goes through Hazten plus sendRequest.

Naming swap: the front 'seller code' (postSellerCode) uses key post_promotion_code_endpoint → /validate-promotion-code → /V1/credito/codigoPromocion with opcion 'ValidarCupon' (creditActions.ts:129-151). The 'recommender code' (postRecommenderCode) uses post_seller_code_endpoint → /validate-seller-code → /V1/credito/codigoRecomendado (creditActions.ts:154-177; index.js:552-594).

The front sends no token on credit-opening calls. mavi-api always signs as the Magento integration (OAuth1), so guest routes rely on resource 'anonymous'. The Credilana guest wizard still prefetches /V1/credito/client/seguros/getSeguros, which is resource 'self' (RegisterCredit.ts:162-164 → index.js:618-638; webapi.xml:173-176), and swallows any error.

save-life-insurance passes config.magento2.api.accessToken as a Bearer token (credilana/index.js:428). That is always the default (VIU) store's key, even when multiStoreConfig selected another store. Credilana existing-client flow only.

ProductosMX and the checkout credit payment are not in the PWA: nothing references /V1/productosmx or omnipro_pago_credito. /checkout is redirected to Magento (external-checkout/router/beforeEach.ts:22-27, registered at client.ts:96). The only credit-related checkout UI is the cart credit-total getters (omni-cart/store/index.ts:25-57) and the product-page CMS block 'credit-payment-conditions' (mavi-theme/components/core/blocks/Product/BottomSection/ProductBottomSection.vue:63).

APERTURA state is not persisted: CreditRegister.vue:80-83 reads sessionStorage 'credit-state', but nothing writes it (only removeItem at CreditRegister.vue:76 and PreAuthorized.vue:106). A reload restarts the wizard at step 0 with a new uuid. Credilana writes 'credilana-state' (Credilana.vue:385).

Dead or unused front code in the APERTURA folder: CreditOpening/CreditExtraDetails.vue, IdentificationImageUpload.vue, Modals/RequirementsModal.vue and Modals/SearchColonyModal.vue are not imported by CreditRegister. Store actions setUserValidation and fetchCustomerService are never dispatched (fetchCustomerService also uses GET while mavi-api exposes POST /customer-service, index.js:706). PreAuthorized's 'Congratulations / Continue' branch needs currentStep===3, but the component renders at steps 4 and 5 (PreAuthorized.vue:78-80; CreditRegister.vue:62-69).

i18n duplicates with different translations in muebles-america-theme/resource/i18n/es-MX.csv: 'Your order number is' at :971 ('pedido') and :1114 ('orden'); 'A 6-digit SMS code has been sent...' at :924, :978 (typos) and :1029. The PreAuthorized wording depends on which duplicate wins.
